title: An open observatory of mortality data would show the next fall in life expectancy as it happens
subtitle: Vellum example deck · illustrative proposal: ten slides in light mode, 1600 × 900 px
data: UN World Population Prospects (2024), Human Mortality Database (2024), Zijdeman and Ribeira da Silva (2015), Riley (2005); processed by Our World in Data, downloaded 2026-10-12; CC BY 4.0
alt: Ten-slide pitch deck. Evidence: world life expectancy fell 1.7 years in 2020–21, the deepest fall since 1960; regional falls ranged from 0.1 to 3.4 years; every region was back above its 2019 level by 2023. The ask, illustrative: €1.2 million over two years.
note: Illustrative proposal: the pipeline, plan, budget and ask are invented; the evidence slides use real data.
